module_notes.WAREHOUSE_INTERIOR: Tight indoor corridors, crate cover, 1-2 door cutouts. Favors stealth/ambush.
module_notes.FORTIFIED_PLAZA: Open exposed ground, sandbag/concrete barrier clusters. Favors direct assault.
module_notes.SLUM_ALLEYWAYS: Dark narrow alley paths, tenement facades. Favors stealth infiltration.
module_notes.URBAN_HIGHWAY: 4-lane asphalt road, sidewalks. Favors vehicles and fast traversal.
module_notes.INDUSTRIAL_DEPOT: Yard with container stacks and fuel barrels. Favors explosive/destructive play.
module_notes.WATERFRONT_DOCKS: Pier with water hazard boundary. Dead-end escape or arrival sector.
module_notes.SECURITY_COMPOUND: Heavily walled perimeter with a guarded gate. Favors heavily armored final stands.
module_notes.OPEN_STREET: Generic navigable street connector, light cover.
module_notes.VACANT_LOT: Generic sparse open connector, minimal cover.
